# Test Fixtures

## hello.wav

- **Format:** WAV PCM_16, 16000 Hz mono, ~3 segundos (48000 amostras)
- **Content:** "olá jarvis" (PT-BR)
- **Generated by:** `espeak-ng -v pt-br -s 130 -w` + resample via `scipy.signal.resample_poly` para 16kHz
- **Used by:** `tests/test_e2e_pipeline.py::test_ptt_full_pipeline_with_mocked_llm`

### Regenerar

Pré-requisito: `sudo apt-get install -y espeak-ng` (Linux) ou equivalente no macOS/Windows.

Comando completo está em `.planning/phases/90-polish-stability/90-02-PLAN.md` Task 1.
